scene: Inside the windmill hub, three curious transit lines await.
picture: Along the wooden plank floor, the mustachioed man in red poncho, straw hat, and guitar stands just left of centre. On the left, a brass book cart lift waits beside a chute. On the right idles a glowing blue night bus, while on the far right a striped ferris gondola hangs docked.
shown: a dangling metal book cart lift on the left, waiting with gates open
a glowing blue night bus parked at an indoor depot on the right
a red striped ferris wheel gondola hanging stationary on the far right
